about: Purpose: the 10 core metrics every agent eval run is measured on, all computed automatically from the run (results.ts). Change when: a metric is added, removed, or measured differently; change results.ts in the same commit. Not for: judged qualities (capabilities.json), the evals themselves (evals.json).

metrics.name: Wall time
metrics.how: From sending the prompt to the agent's screen settling, timed by agent.ts.

metrics.name: Time to first action
metrics.how: From the prompt entry to the first assistant entry in the session.

metrics.name: Tool calls
metrics.how: Tool call blocks in assistant messages.

metrics.name: Repeated tool calls
metrics.how: Tool calls whose tool name and arguments already appeared earlier in the session.

metrics.name: Input tokens
metrics.how: Prompt tokens per assistant message, fresh plus cache read, summed.

metrics.name: Output tokens
metrics.how: Generated tokens per assistant message, thinking included, summed.

metrics.name: Compactions
metrics.how: Compaction entries: times the agent ran out of context.

metrics.name: Files changed
metrics.how: Files added, modified, or deleted in the sandbox's writable folders during the run, outside the harness's own Pi and Herdr state.
